_doc: Bosch Rexroth's swivel-in sliding block for its 6 mm slot, M5 (3 842 547 825). Stainless only in the 6 mm slot. Rexroth rates no Fmax for it in this slot.
name: slot-nut-6-bosch-m5-roll-in

slot.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-8

thread.rule: Thread M5, one of the sizes the table lists (M3, M4, M5)
thread.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-8

nut_kind.rule: Swivelled in through the opening at the place it is wanted
nut_kind.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-8

length.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-8

width.rule: Across the slot: the drawing gives no figure; taken as Rexroth's 6 mm T-nut (11.5), under the 12 mm cavity
width.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-8: not dimensioned there, so an estimate

height.rule: The body under the lips: h = 3.0 less h1 = 0.9 in the table
height.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-8

tongue_height.rule: The step into the opening: h1 = 0.9 in the table
tongue_height.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-8

nut_entry.rule: Put in through the opening anywhere along the slot
nut_entry.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-8

material.rule: Material as the table names it
material.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-8

hold.rule: Rexroth rates its swivel-in block with a spring at 2200 N in an 8 mm slot against 6000 N for its sliding block; the same share of the 6 mm sliding block's 3000 N. An estimate until it is tested (Frames 2.13): the maker gives no figure for this nut
hold.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4 to 3-9; the proof stress from the kit's m5 thread set (ISO 898-1)
